item: Games decided by one score (<=8 pts)
reading: A large share of results is decided by one possession; a season-long record therefore carries a lot of variance that no model can remove.

item: Pythagorean expected wins vs actual (32 clubs)
reading: No league-wide bias (-0.67 wins), but the club-level spread is SD 1.08 wins. That spread is the luck a season-long win-rate leaderboard would reward.

item: Model margin SD vs actual margin SD
reading: Predicted SD 5.24 against actual SD 12.91. A ratio below 1 means the model is under-spread and its probabilities are too timid; that is a calibration defect, not a skill claim.
